title: Pay an invoice once — refuse the retry
narrative: An invoice arrives and the AP agent pays it; KIFF allows the first payment and signs a receipt. The app debits and marks the invoice PAID. Then a flaky connection makes the agent retry the same payment — and KIFF refuses it, because PAY_INVOICE is only allowed while the invoice is PENDING. The refusal is signed too. Pay-once is the state machine, not a dedupe table.

steps.description: The agent pays the invoice. Allowed — the invoice is PENDING. Signed receipt.
The app debited and marks the invoice PAID (state → PAID).
A retry hits the now-PAID invoice. KIFF refuses it (state_not_allowed) — no double debit. Signed refusal.
